title: 15th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/15/2024).
Preliminary debate on the bill to amend the Mutual Legal Assistance in Criminal Matters Act (Law No. 2/2015), submitted on behalf of the government by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the bill to amend the Criminal Procedure Act (Law No. 12/2016), submitted on behalf of the government by Manadhoo MP Husnee Mubarik.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting opened debate on the Mutual Legal Assistance Act amendment and continued debating the Criminal Procedure Act amendment.
